passages.text: Multi-head attention allows the model to jointly attend to information from different representation subspaces at different positions. MultiHead(Q, K, V) = Concat(head_1, ..., head_h)W^O where head_i = Attention(Q W_i^Q, K W_i^K, V W_i^V).
